_comment: Generated from replication.config.json by scripts/setup.py; edit that file instead. Machine-specific fields are filled in by the setup.

model.sampling_note: Recommended sampling with a fixed seed via per-request samplingParams in config/pi-models.json (llama-server unchanged). Greedy decoding (the Stage 4 choice) was dropped during the EC run: an A0 probe fell into a thinking repetition loop until the 30-min timeout. See SETUP.md SAMPLING_SETUP.

schedule._comment: The paper's runs shared a server and were limited to a nightly window; the replication scripts set CEVAL_IGNORE_WINDOW=1, so this window does not apply.

extension._registry_comment: Extensions an arm can load (arms.<arm>.extensions). install 'copy': the file is copied into the arm's wd/.pi/extensions/ (verbatim); 'in-place': loaded from its cloned repository with its own node_modules (pi-vcc). scripts/setup.py fills in the cloned paths. The bridge loads exactly the arm's list.

fold._comment: pi-fold arm (docs/build/comparison-arms.md). Run as shipped (decided 2026-10-06): options is empty, so registerPiFold uses its defaults (maxTarget 0.80, minTarget 0.20, budget = window - min(16384, 10% of window)). The study model is declared with a 128k window (config/pi-models.json), as for every arm, so the budget is 128000 - 12800 = 115200: a commit fires at >= 92160 tokens and aims at 23040. pi-fold commits only in the context hook of a measured turn, so each round ends with the commit turn: two prompts in one bridge process (the first reply's provider usage is the measurement pi-fold requires; the second prompt's context hook commits). If a commit does not fire, the treatment check records it; nothing is tuned.
fold._options_comment: providerInputBudget 72000 (the user's decision, 2026-10-06: tell pi-fold the window is smaller so that it folds at every round end). With pi-fold's default thresholds the trigger is 0.80 x 72000 = 57600 tokens and the target 0.20 x 72000 = 14400. At the 128k default (budget 115200, trigger 92160) the first smoke run folded round 1 from 95.7k to 8.8k provider tokens, so round 2 would end near 63-66k, under the trigger, and not fold. All other pi-fold settings are its defaults.
fold._commit_comment: commit 'turn' (used): commit_messages run in one bridge process; pi-fold folds in the second prompt's context hook if the first reply measured occupancy >= its trigger. commit 'command' (tried 2026-10-06, not usable as shipped): bare /fold commits only staged marks, and pi-fold stages marks only inside an automatic commit (a measured reply at >= maxTarget), so on synthetic history /fold finds nothing to commit ('nothing-proposable'). Forcing a fold would need changing pi-fold's thresholds, which the study does not do.

vcc._comment: pi-vcc arm (secondary, added after prereg-v2: DEVIATIONS.md; docs/build/comparison-arms.md). Run as shipped: no pi-vcc config is written by the harness; the package scaffolds its defaults (overrideDefaultCompaction true, debug false, no thresholds) into PI_VCC_CONFIG_PATH, which the harness points into the line's private HOME (driver.vcc_config_path) so nothing is written to the real ~/.pi/agent. With no thresholds configured, its proactive trigger never fires; compactions come only from the harness's session.compact() at each round end, as for the other arms.

usage_proxy._comment: Token and time accounting for every model call (harness/src/ceval/usageproxy.py): the runner forwards pi's requests through a local proxy to this upstream and records the usage the server reports. Needed because pi's session file omits extension and summary calls and the server's /metrics is disabled.

_arms_comment: extensions: the registry names the arm loads (exactly these; [] loads none). compactor: what must have produced the arm's compaction rows ('pi' = pi's own summary; else a registry compactor), checked per row (treatment check). commit_turn: no pi compaction; one fixed short turn per round on the main line instead (pi-fold folds in its context hook). compact_timeout_s overrides bridge.compact_timeout_s.
